Description
Coldridge Prison: Half-Life 2 Style (ver. 1.0.2)

"Shall we gather for whiskey and cigars tonight?"

This isn't a direct one-to-one port of the level; some things had to be cut or condensed to seamlessly blend everything together and capture the aesthetic of both Half-Life 2 and Dishonored. However, I did try to include mechanics that you would have encountered in the game. It took me just over two months, and I hope the result was worth it.

This map was made by using Hammer++ and requires no additional addons or games, all custom content is included. I’ve tried to optimize everything I can, but you might still experience lags, especially on low-end PCs. Please let me know in the comments if you notice any errors, bugs, or missing textures.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

Map features:
  • Almost whole Coldridge Prison area recreation;
  • CSM Support version;
  • AI-Nodes (ground/air);
  • Nav-meshes;
  • Cubemaps (only on HDR);
  • Few easter-eggs.

P.S. If you don't really like how the reflections (cubemaps) work on this map, use mat_specular 0/1 command to turn it off/on.

Credits:
  • Romeevan - map creator;
  • A-Shift - custom made decals for Dark Interval (and some little edits by me);
  • Valve Software and Turtle Rock Studios - Half-Life 2 and Counter-Strike: Source assets;
  • Arkane Studios and Bethesda Softworks - Dishonored;
  • Facepunch and garry - Garry's Mod.

Special Thanks to:

  • Raphaël Colantonio, Harvey Smith, Viktor Antonov, Jean-Luc Monnet, Sébastien Mitton, Christophe Carrier and whole Arkane Studios – for the wonderful game they created;
  • My friends and comrades (Night_K0T, miman2020, Veniamin, N_T_D_, Piggo) – for the ideas and playtesting;
  • Cvoxalury – for the safe door mechanic prefab;
  • Dark Interval Discord Community, Map Labs Discord Server, LambdaGeneration, r/Hammer and r/Dishonored subbreddits – for the motivating feedback and positive reaction to my work.

"This is my last map," I wrote beneath my last map. We all make mistakes, don't we?
